text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: In order to resolve the errors in the Alpha Avatars, which were recreated from past data, Labyrista and {0} headed for the well-equipped hideout of "Labyrinth".
text_block_list.orig_text:
過去のデータより再現された『始原の冠装』のエラーを解消すべく、
ラビリスタは{0}と共に
設備の整っているアジトを目指していた。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: ...Whoops, stop. There's a reaction... a monster is approaching from that corner. Come here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──おっと、
ストップ。
その角に
接近する魔物の反応あり。
こっちに来て。

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Alright, alright. That one passed without noticing us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よしよし、
こっちに気づかずに通り過ぎて行ったね。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Oh? There's a Gear Blade lying around. Boy, equip it. It's merely a tacky small blade, but it will increase your attack power.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっ？　
ギアブレードが落ちてる。
少年、
装備しておいて。
付け焼き刃程度だけど
攻撃力が上がるから。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: That's right, I forgot. I'll give you this too while I'm at it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ、
忘れてた。
ついでにこれも渡しておこう。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Every explorer who wants to carry that name with respect has a 10-foot stick! It's an ancient, traditional item that was carried by everyone who ventured into a dungeon.
text_block_list.orig_text:
探索者には
10フィートの棒が付き物だよね！
ダンジョンに挑む者たちは皆携えていたという、
古式ゆかしき伝統のアイテムさ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Converted into meters, this is 3 meters and 48 mm. It fits perfectly in your hand, with a reliable weight and length...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
メートル換算すると
３メートルと48ミリ。
実に手に馴染む、
この
頼りがいのある重さと長さ……！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Now then, you're up, Boy. Bang on the walls and floors with that, good luck!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さて、
それじゃ少年。
壁と床バンバン、
よろしく頼んだ！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Right, go ahead. If there's anything you deem suspicious, just keep tapping and poking around to investigate! You never know what kind of traps might be set.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そそ。
怪しいとこは叩くなり、
突っつくなりして
どんどん調べちゃって！
どんな罠が仕掛けられてるか分かんないからね。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: I don't recall making any nasty instant death traps like strong acid showers or laser grids... Something's around here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
強酸のシャワーとか
レーザー格子とか
悪趣味な即死トラップは
流石に作った覚えないけど……
この辺とか？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Whoops, it's a switchblade. I thought it was a booby trap.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっと、
飛び出し槍だったか。
仕掛け矢のトラップかと思ったけど。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Well, it's better for you to assume traps like these are what you'll find. Boy, do you now understand the importance of that wooden stick?
text_block_list.orig_text:
とまあ、
こうした罠が仕掛けられてるって思った方がいい。
少年にも、
この木の棒の重要性が分かってもらえたかな？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Very well. Now then... I'll be taking care of this second one myself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よろしい。
さてアタシも……
二本目を
取り出しまして
っと。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The two of them carefully progressed through the dungeon, poking at every wall and floor they could see.
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人は目に見える範囲の壁や床を片っ端から突っつき回し、
慎重にダンジョンを進んでいった。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Phew... We've dived quite deep into this maze. We're going at a pretty fast pace, but I'm worried about our levels and equipment at this rate...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ……
だいぶ潜ってきたね。
かなり速いペースだけど、
このままだと
レベルと装備が心配だな……

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: The former can be managed by defeating the monsters, but the latter... huh? This familiar shape of a fork in the road, perhaps...
text_block_list.orig_text:
前者は魔物を倒せばどうにかなるとして後者は……
お？
この見覚えある分岐路の形は、
もしかして……

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Boy, you still have room in your backpack, right? Let's take a little detour.
text_block_list.orig_text:
少年、
バックパックには
まだ荷物入るよね？
ちょっと寄り道して行こう。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Bingo! I knew it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ビンゴ！　
やっぱりだ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: If this is a dungeon, there must be items and equipment placed here. In what is commonly known as a "Treasure Room".
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここが作られたダンジョンなら、
必ずアイテムや装備品が配置されているはず。
いわゆる
『アイテム部屋』
ってやつがさ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Furthermore, if we're following the premise of a game...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってなると、
ゲームのお約束でいえば……

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's wrong? Suddenly stopping just like that. Don't worry, come and take a look, there shouldn't have been any traps set up from what I recall.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
どしたの
そんな所で止まっちゃって？
部屋を見てみよう。
大丈夫、
設定した通りなら
罠は仕掛けられてないはずだ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: First, let's hold up a vase that we have lying around... Here we go!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まずは、
そこらにある壺を掲げまして……
よいしょおー！！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Oh, herbs, huh. I'll take them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
薬草か。
もらっておこう。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Come on, help me out, Boy. We need to check all the vases, barrels, treasure chests, and dressers here. Oh, I found a coin!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
少年も手伝ってよ。
ここにある
壺と
タル、
宝箱、
タンスを
ぜーんぶ調べないと。
あ、
コインめっけ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Even the most famous heroes in the world started out with these steady efforts, you know.
text_block_list.orig_text:
世に名だたる勇者様だって、
最初はこういう地道な積み重ねからやっていくもんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: For those of us who are progressing at a low level, a single item can mean the difference between life and death. And surprisingly, there are many important little trinkets in these places...
text_block_list.orig_text:
低レベルで進行中のアタシたちにとっては、
たった一つのアイテムが生死を分けることもある。
それに、
意外とこうした所に大事なものが……

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Oh, luckyyyy! This pendant has the blessing of increasing defense power. Here you go, Boy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっ、
ラッキー！
防御力アップの加護がついてるペンダントだ。
ほい、
少年っ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: {0} took the pendant that Labyrista had tossed at him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ラビリスタの放り投げたペンダントを
{0}は受け取った。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Since you're in the vanguard, it'd be best for you to have that, Boy. Equip it now. "There's no point in having weapons and armor if you don't equip them!", as they say.
text_block_list.orig_text:
前衛に立つ少年が持ってた方がいいでしょ。
今のうちに装備しておいて。
「武器や防具なんかは
装備しないと意味がないぞ！」
ってね。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Looks like we've got everything we need around here. My luggage is packed, so this should be enough. Let's move on.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この辺りのアイテムは取り尽くしたね。
荷物もパンパンだし、
これだけあれば十分。
先に進もう。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Based on the look of things, it seems we're approaching the climax. I hope nothing bad happens...
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシの予想だと、
そろそろクライマックスかな。
このまま何事もなければいいけど……

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Boy, even you would realize this, if you were playing a game, right? The healing items, weapons, and equipment are all placed as if they were tailor-made. It's like they're telling you to get prepared...
text_block_list.orig_text:
少年だって
ゲームで遊ぶなら気づくんじゃない？
あつらえたように配置された回復アイテム、
武器、
装備品。
いかにも準備してくれって
言わんばかりだよね。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: ...For the Boss Fight, that is.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ボス戦に備えて、
さ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: We should be arriving at the core of the dungeon soon enough... Huh? That’s weird, there’s nothing here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そろそろダンジョンのゴールに着くはずだけど……
あれぇ？　
おっかしいなぁ、
何にもないや。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I shouldn't have said that so confidently... If there was a hole, I'd like to live in it~ Well, we're already underground, so you could say this is pretty much the same thing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うっ……
自信満々に言わなきゃよかった……
穴があったら入りたいよ～
ここ
地下だからとっくに入ってるって言えなくもないけど。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Well, it's better to avoid unnecessary battles if we can help it. However, let's not let our guard down until the end.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ
余分な戦闘をしないで済むに越したことはないしね。
とはいえ、
最後まで油断せずに行こう。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Boy, you know what that means, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
少年、
やる事は分かってるね？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Good! I'm relieved to see that you haven't let your guard down. Traps usually bare their fangs exactly at that moment.
text_block_list.orig_text:
グッド！　
警戒を怠ってないようで安心だ。
罠ってのは
油断した頃に牙を剥いてくるからね。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: So you'll be searching clockwise, Boy, while I will search counterclockwise. Let's hope there's nothing troublesome in here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ
少年は右回り、
アタシは左回りで調べよう。
何も出ない事を祈りたいけど。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: ...Tch! Get down!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──っ、
伏せて！！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Wheeeew, that was close! I'm sorry I pushed you down! Are you hurt?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひゅー、
危なかったぁ！
押し倒しちゃってゴメンね！　
怪我はない？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Whoops, don't get up just yet. Keep your posture... Over there, can you see it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっと、
身を起こさないで。
そのままの姿勢で……
あっちの方、
見える？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: But why, of all places, in front of the exit... I know it's a foreboding way of doing things, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
しっかし、
よりによって出口の前かぁ……
お約束っちゃお約束だけどさぁ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: From what I can tell, its armor looks hard enough? And its range of attack is nothing to scoff at? What should we do...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
見るからに装甲は硬そうだし、
射程は向こうの方が上っぽい感じ？
どうしたもんか……

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: With this weapon, I'm sure my attacks will reach it, sure... Boy, can you strengthen me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
この武器だと
届くのは届くだろうけど……
少年、
強化を頼める？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Keep your head down. Even if I fire from the front, the slope of the armor will likely cause the bullet to bounce off. I guess I'll just have to rely on a ricochet from a gap...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そのまま伏せてて。
真正面から撃っても装甲の傾斜で弾かれるだろうし。
隙間からの跳弾に賭けるしかないか……

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: I hope it works out somehow... There!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんとかなってくれればいいけど……
なっ！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: How do you like this!?
text_block_list.orig_text: どうだっ！？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Uwacchi?! It didn't work after all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわっち！？
やっぱダメだったかぁ～！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: That was the maximum firepower I could produce against it right now... Ugh, I'm at my wit's end! What should we do?
text_block_list.orig_text:
今のアタシたちに出せる最大火力だったんだけど……
うーん、
お手上げ！　
どうしようね？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Now that it's come to this, we only have two strategies ahead of us. One is to retreat from here and return after having leveled up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうなると作戦は二つ。
一つは、
ここから退却してレベル上げに戻る案。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: If we defeat other monsters and increase our statuses inside of this dungeon, we should be able to penetrate the enemy’s defenses and deal damage...
text_block_list.orig_text:
他の魔物を倒してダンジョン内ステータスが上がれば、
敵の防御を貫通してダメージが通るようになるはず……

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: ...But unfortunately, that's out of the question. The attack just now has blocked our escape route.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……だったけど、
残念ながら却下だね。
今の攻撃で退路が塞がれちゃった。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Therefore, we'll have to go with plan B.
text_block_list.orig_text:
となると、
プランBの出番かな。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: I'd like to get past that thing's attacks and break through head-on... but in our current predicament, it's probably impossible to hit its weak spot.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アイツの攻撃をかいくぐって真正面から突破──
……したいのは山々だけど、
今のアタシたちじゃ
弱点を突いても無理だろう。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: That's why our goal right now isn't to defeat it. It's to buy me enough time so that I can repair my Alpha Avatar. I'm going to bring some cheat equipment into this labyrinth.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから
目指すのは撃破じゃない。
アタシが『始原の冠装』を調整する時間稼ぎだ。
この迷宮内にチート装備を持ち込んでやるってこと。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Fortunately, I could see that the entrace to the Labyrinth's hideout is right behind that Boss. I'm glad that it made it just barely outside this dungeon's instance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
幸い、
アジトの入口はボスの背後にもう見えてる。
ダンジョン化の範囲内にギリギリ入ってたみたいで良かった。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that was close...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っと、
あっぶなぁ～……！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: If we carry on like this, we won't have anything to use as a shield, and we'll end up getting a deep sunburn from those rays.
text_block_list.orig_text:
このままだと
盾にする遮蔽物が無くなって、
あの光線で
こんがり日焼けする羽目になっちゃうな。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Boy, if this plan were to work and I'd be able to regain my original powers, I'll be able to take care of it in an instant. But... I can't deny it that there's a high risk involved for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
少年、
アタシが本来の力を取り戻せば
一瞬で片を付けられる。
ただ……
リスクが大きいのも確かだ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: If you've got a better plan in store, I'd like to hear it. Know that we don't have much time to consider other options, though...
text_block_list.orig_text:
他に良い作戦があれば聞きたい。
悩んでる時間はあんまり無いけれど……

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: An immediate answer, huh. I know I'm the one who asked, but I'm surprised to see your resolution nonetheless.
text_block_list.orig_text:
即答かぁ。
言い出しておいてなんだけど、
返事が早すぎて面食らっちゃったよ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: It's true that this is the plan with the highest chance of success that I can present you, but... You understand that I'm trying to have you act as a decoy for me, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに
これがアタシの提示できる中で
勝算が一番高い作戦だけど……
囮になってもらうって事は理解してる、
よね？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: And?
text_block_list.orig_text: それに？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: ......Ah. ...Hah, you're making me all happy now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
…………
……ははっ、
うれしい事を言ってくれるなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: That's exactly right. You're my Princess Knight, Boy. Then let's both make this enemy regret its luck today!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ、
少年は
アタシのプリンセスナイトだ。
なら二人で
あの敵に吠え面をかかせてやるとしよう。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Listen, we'll split up and launch a surprise attack on Oram, then I'll charge straight into our hideout, while you'll hold it at close range so that it doesn't fire any beam at me, OK?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいかい、
このまま二手に分かれてオラムに急襲、
アタシはそのままアジトに突入、
少年は光線を食らわないよう接近戦で足止め、
OK？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: I'll handle the enemy's first attack. I'm counting on you, Boy--NOW!
text_block_list.orig_text:
敵の初撃はアタシがなんとかする。
頼んだよ、
少年──
今だっ！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: I WON'T LET YOU SHOOT!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 撃たせないっての！！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: So far everything's going according to plan! Just wait for me, I'll wrap things up right away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここまでは作戦通り！
待ってて、
すぐに終わらせてくる！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Hold up! Enemies... none. It seems the effects of the dungeon truly haven't reached this interior just yet.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ホールドアップ！　
敵影は……
なし。
内部まではダンジョン化の影響が及んでないのか。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Then, I suppose I should get to work. I'll take out my secret magic key and... Activate!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なら、
さっさと仕事に取り掛かろう。
秘
密の魔法鍵を取り出しましてっと……
起動！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Console open, go through the system area... Temporarily turn off comprehensive security... Build a data corruption detection routine and a pipeline for conversion──
text_block_list.orig_text:
コンソールオープン、
システム領域を経由して～……
広範セキュリティを一時的にオフ、
データの破損探査ルーチンと
コンバート用のパイプラインを構築──

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Uwah, how was this thing even moving... the internal structure is all messed up. No, maybe this is my fault because I forced it to move.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーわ、
よく動いてたなこれ……
構造が滅茶苦茶になってる。
いや、
無理に動かしたからこうなったのか。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: I'm glad I got here before I was fatally damaged. That said... it's worse than I expected.
text_block_list.orig_text:
致命的に破損する前でよかったよ。
とはいえ……
予想外に酷いな。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: This is such an unreasonable demand, it's almost like having to separate the minced meat mixed together with potatoes in a croquette and return them to their original state.
text_block_list.orig_text:
コロッケのために混ぜたひき肉とジャガイモを、
オペして元の状態に戻せ
ってくらい無理難題だ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: ...Almost... As long as I wasn't here to fix it, that is.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ここにいるのがアタシじゃなければ、
だけど。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Now, it's time for a bug-fixing time attack. I'll try an attempt at breaking the world record!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ、
バグ修正のタイムアタックだ。
ちょっくら
ワールドレコードに挑戦してみようか！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: I won't let you!!
text_block_list.orig_text: させるかっ！！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Sorry, sorry, it took me a while! Even so, I'm glad I made it in time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんごめん、
ちょっと時間かかっちゃった！
だけど
間に合って何よりだ！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Whoops, you're still up for a fight? I appreciate your enthusiasm, but maybe you should pick your opponents a little better.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっと、
まだやる気？
気合は買うけど、
相手が悪いんじゃないかな。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: The power that I was holding back until now--I've unleashed it all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきまで制限してた力──
まるっと全部解放してきたんだ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: As promised, I will take care of this in merely an instant. Boy, I want to show someone like you who's worked hard up until now just how cool I can be!
text_block_list.orig_text:
約束通り、
一瞬で片を付けよう。
ここまで頑張ってくれた少年に、
ちょっとはカッコイイ所見せたいしね！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Now, witness the strength--of the Seven Crowns!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ、
七冠の実力──
とくとご覧あれ！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Boss fight, complete... Boy, are you hurt?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボス撃破
っと……
少年、
怪我は？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Umm, as for your stamina, Boy... Wow, that was a close call. Things would've been bad if you didn't have that defense up pendant I gave you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと、
少年の体力は……
わぉ、
結構ギリギリ。
ペンダントの防御力アップが無かったらまずかったね。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm glad you're safe for now. Thanks to you, the adjustments to my avatar are complete. The Grand Resurrection of Queen Labyrinth! How does that sound?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
とりあえずは無事で何より。
おかげさまで調整は終わったよ。
迷宮女王、
大
復
活！　
ってところかな？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Ah, it seems this area's returned to normal too. The monsters that were appearing here and there due to the dungeonization should have disappeared.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
この付近も正常化したね。
ダンジョン化の影響であちこちに湧いてた魔物も消えたはずだ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Even someone like you can get tired after all that, huh, Boy. I'm sorry for leaving you the task of slowing that thing down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さすがの少年もお疲れ気味って感じかな。
ごめんね～、
足止めなんて無茶を頼んじゃって。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: But there's still just one thing left for us to work on. Could you come with me for a bit longer?
text_block_list.orig_text:
だけど、
まだやるべき作業が残ってるんだ。
あ
とちょっとだけ
付き合ってくれないかな。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Let's see, to correct the discrepancy between the structure of the previous version and the current one... I'll have to... rearrange this over here and...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えーっと、
過去バージョンの構造と
現在とのズレを直すには……
ここを組み替えて……

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Yeah. An update patch for the other two's "Alpha Avatars". Since we're here I thought it might've been a good idea to go through the trouble.
text_block_list.orig_text:
んー？　
うん。
ほか二人の『始原の冠装』アップデートパッチ。
ついでに
作っておいた方がいいかな
って。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: If something is wrong with me, then there's a chance that Chris and Neneka might have problems too, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシのに異常が出たって事は、
クリスやネネカの方でも
不具合が出る可能性があるでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: So far, I haven't heard of any particular problems occurring... That said, having such a problem occur during a battle would be a very bad idea. Well, I think those two would be able to do something about it regardless.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今の所、
特に問題が起きたって話は聞いてないけど……
戦闘中にいきなりエラーとか困るからさ。
ま、
あの二人なら
それでも何とかしちゃう気もするけど。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: ...And while I was saying that, here! I'm done! Let's go and do some deliveries.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……と、言ってる間に完成っ！
それじゃ
渡しに行くとしますか。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Haha, you don't have to sigh so loudly. We'll be back in no time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ははっ、
そんな大きいため息をつかなくてもいいよ。
帰りはあっという間だから。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: After all, I can use my power now. I've made the proper adjustments, so even if a mistake were to happen, we still wouldn't end up "inside a stone".
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにせ、
今は権能が使えるからね。
しっかり調整したし、
間違っても
「いしのなかにいる」
なんて事にはならないさ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Authority, release! Object change... I'm ready.
text_block_list.orig_text:
権能、
解放！
オブジェクト変更
っと……
準備できたよ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Let's go, then. We might get caught into a battle whenever we meet one of those two... I hope that won't happen though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃ、
行こうか。
あの二人に出くわした先で戦闘に巻き込まれる……
なんて事にならなきゃいいけど。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Even if I triggered a flag, I'm sure things will still be fine! If the newly revived me and the Boy are together, most situations can be managed!
text_block_list.orig_text:
フラグが立っても大丈夫だって！
復活したアタシと少年が揃えば、
大抵の状況はなんとかなる！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: So with that said, I'm counting on you... my Princess Knight!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういう訳で
頼りにしてるよ？
アタシのプリンセスナイト！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Thus, the two of them set off to find Christina and Neneka in order to deliver the update patch for the "Alpha Avatars".
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして『始原の冠装』のアップデートパッチを渡すため、
二人はクリスティーナとネネカを探しに行くのだった。
